## Summary

"Prove the whole docker loop as throwaway POC: build container with named-volume cargo caches, minimal /health daemon, POC compose (db shape from s001 + daemon), db-safe reload loop, engine-agnostic lint, results writeup with timings and go/no-go for phase 2."
